name: Anywhere
long_description:
Anywhere is a personal, social map that brings your places, friends, plans, memories, and AI agents together. It gives you one place to discover where to go, organize the places you care about, and remember where you’ve been.

Built by the team behind Zenly, Bump & Life360.
one_liner: Your places, plans, friends and memories, all on one living map

founders.title: Founder/CEO
founders.founder_bio:
Cofounder and CEO at Fenn AI.
Previously Principal Engineer at Life360, completely rebuilt the map experience across iOS and Android - as a two person team.
Cofounded amo (bump app), leading mobile & recruitment.
Early Zenly employee pre-Snap acquisition, leading the map effort, from engineering to experience, creating many unique interaction pattern. Shipped a cross-platform C++ map engine made from scratch: 
https://techcrunch.com/2022/05/18/social-maps-app-zenly-rolls-out-its-own-maps/
